content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab Canada Corp to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand, how does the maximum number of paid sick days they can take in a single extended absence differ between the two companies?","answer":"In Canada the employee can receive up to 25 paid sick days, while in New Zealand the maximum is 20 days under the Holidays Act.","evidence_a":"GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days","evidence_b":"Maximum accumulation: 20 days under New Zealand's Holidays Act 2003"}
